_readme: Luxora deals feed. SAMPLE DATA ONLY: these are made-up demo deals for a prototype, not real offers. The shop view reads this file to show deal badges and the Deals section; the EMAIL bot reads it to write deal emails. Edit this file (and push) to change the deals. Fields per deal: id, productId (matches products.js / the shop), productName, listPrice, dealPrice (USD), discountPercent, endsAt (ISO 8601 with offset; the deal disappears from the shop after this time), headline, url (deep link to the product in the shop), sample (true = demo deal).
